title: 第14章 获利离场，290万
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
丰龙股份的盘子小。

    算不上什么大体量的标的。

    市值就只有32亿。

    筹码并不集中，有很多像李西雄一样的散户。

    现在的基本面，看似行情走势大跌。

    实则是知道内幕消息的主力，在暴力洗盘抢筹码。

    同样，他们在抢时间。

    半个月。

    时间没多久了。

    一晃就过。

    要还是不抓紧的话。

    丰龙股份发布最后的公告，行情就不是主力能够掌控的。

    筹码越多，才能吃到越庞大的收益。

    “雄哥，你怎么想着进这支股票的啊。”

    李西朋不明白的问道。

    “还能怎么想的，有感觉呗。”李西雄倒是说的简单，反正就是看好，有感觉。

    李西海心想，你这个感觉还真不一般啊。

    确实是选了一支逆天妖王。

    只是现在暴力洗盘，就是不知道能不能撑到最后。

    “雄哥，你现在怎么想？”李西海问道。

    “我也不知道。”李西雄道：“亏了这么多，要我走真不甘心。”

    “我五十万进去的，现在亏了十几个。”

    李西朋笑嘻嘻道：“我昨天刷了个视频，说什么加仓猛干，越跌越补。”

    “雄哥，不甘心，要不继续补仓。”

    李西雄道：“你还别说，我真有这想法。”

    “吗的，反正都这样了，只要跌停补仓，每一次都是抄底。”

    李西朋摆手道：“别，我就是开个玩笑，别的不懂。”

    “我知道，我个人是这么想的。”

    李西雄看向李西海，道：“西海，你有什么建议吗？”

    “我？”

    李西海微微一顿，李西雄是他亲堂哥，李大兴他们这几个亲兄弟姐妹，关系都很不错，感情很好。

    每年过年，都是一起吃的团年饭。

    时节水果，海鲜什么的，都是送个不停。

    李西海要是一声不吭，李西雄亏钱离场，后来大涨。

    以后知道他在丰龙股份操作，赚了这么多钱。

    到时候兄弟父辈之间，很难相处面对的。

    “我倒是想入手试试，反正再跌也跌不到哪里去了。”

    李西海说道。

    三个跌停是人为制造的恐慌，后面就会撬板放人，洗掉意志不坚定的散户，吃他们手上的筹码。

    “对，就是这么个道理。”

    李西雄狠狠的说道：“三个跌停板，亏了这么多就让我走，怎么可能。”

    “干就完事。”

    三兄弟喝着茶，随便聊着。

    因为带了海鲜，提前两个小时散伙。

    “西海，回头多联系。”

    “咱们兄弟也算是一个战壕的了。”
content_en:
The plate of Fenglong shares is small.

    It's not a large-scale target.

    The market value is only 3.2 billion.

    The chips are not concentrated and there are many retail investors like Li Xixiong.

    The current fundamentals look like the market is headed for a sharp decline.

    In fact, it is the main force who knows the inside information and is violently washing the market to grab chips.

    Again, they are competing for time.

    Half a month.

    Time is running out.

    It passed in a flash.

    If you still don't hurry up.

    Fenglong Co., Ltd. issued the final announcement, and the market situation was beyond the control of the main force.

    The more chips you have, the bigger your profits will be.

    "Brother Xiong, why are you thinking about buying this stock?"

    Li Xipeng asked confused.

    "What else can I think about? I just have a feeling." Li Xixiong said simply. Anyway, he is optimistic and has a feeling.

    Li Xihai thought to himself, your feeling is really extraordinary.

    He indeed chose a heaven-defying Demon King.

    It's just that now that we are violently washing the market, we don't know if we can survive until the end.

    "Brother Xiong, what do you think now?" Li Xihai asked.

    "I don't know either." Li Xixiong said, "After losing so much, I really don't want to leave."

    "I entered with half a million, and now I've lost more than a dozen."

    Li Xipeng said with a smile: "I watched a video yesterday, saying that I want to increase my position and work hard. The more I fall, the more I make up for it."

    "Brother Xiong, if you don't want to give in, please continue to cover your position."

    Li Xixiong said: "Don't tell me yet, I really have this idea."

    "Yeah, it's like this anyway. As long as the price drops to the limit to cover the position, it's like buying the bottom every time."

    Li Xipeng waved his hand and said: "No, I was just joking, I don't understand anything else."

    "I know, that's what I personally think."

    Li Xixiong looked at Li Xihai and said, "Xihai, do you have any suggestions?"

    "Me?"

    Li Xihai paused slightly. Li Xixiong was his cousin. Li Daxing and his brothers and sisters had a good relationship and a good relationship.

    Every New Year, we have a reunion dinner together.

    Seasonal fruits, seafood, etc. are always delivered.

    If Li Xihai had remained silent, Li Xixiong would have left the market with a loss and later gained sharply.

    Later I learned that he had made so much money by operating Fenglong shares.

    At that time, it will be difficult for brothers and fathers to get along with each other.

    "I would like to try it. Anyway, no matter how hard it falls, it won't fall any further."

    Li Xihai said.

    The three lower limits are an artificial panic, and people will be released later to wash away the unsteady retail investors and eat the chips in their hands.

    "Yes, that's the truth."

    Li Xixiong said harshly: "It's three times lower than the limit, and you let me go after losing so much. How is it possible?"

    "Just do it and it's done."

    The three brothers drank tea and chatted casually.

    Because I brought seafood, we left two hours early.

    "Xihai, please contact us later."

    "We brothers can be considered as one from the same trench."
title_en: Chapter 14: Leaving the market with profit, 2.9 million
